$comment: SDK names for the openapi.json schemas whose generated names are not fit for public types: FastAPI qualifies a name with its module path when two models share it (dsp__features__...), and pydantic names a generic model's instantiation after its parameters (DocumentSort_PatentSortField_). Each SDK's generator uses the names below (through spec/models.json) and refuses to generate if any other name holds an underscore. Each new name says which feature the schema belongs to.
